onboarding.welcomeBody: Snap a photo, scan a barcode or search – Kalo works out how much you can eat for your goal and adjusts the plan every week to your real progress. Setup takes about a minute.
onboarding.disclaimer: Kalo is not a medical device and does not replace advice from a doctor or dietitian. If you have health conditions, are pregnant or breastfeeding, or have an eating disorder, please talk to a professional first.
onboarding.sexHint: Only used for the metabolic rate formula.
onboarding.activityTitle: How active are you – including exercise?

sedentary.title: Mostly inactive
sedentary.subtitle: Desk job, little movement, no exercise

light.title: Lightly active
light.subtitle: On your feet a lot or exercise 1–3× a week

moderate.title: Active
moderate.subtitle: Active daily life or exercise 3–5× a week

active.title: Very active
active.subtitle: Physical job or exercise 6–7× a week

very_active.title: Extremely active
very_active.subtitle: Competitive sport or hard physical work

paceGain.fast: Large surplus, faster but more fat

onboarding.planExplain: Kalo starts with these numbers and compares your weight with what you ate every week. If your pace differs from the plan, the coach suggests an adjustment – with an explanation.

coach.previewLine: Preview: {{kcal}} kcal a day · {{protein}} g protein
coach.planDetails: BMR {{bmr}} kcal · TDEE {{tdee}} kcal · water {{water}} l
coach.weeklyLoss: Expected: about {{kg}} kg less per week
coach.weeklyGain: Expected: about {{kg}} kg more per week
coach.clamped: Your target was raised to a safe minimum. Progress is a bit slower – but sustainable.

minor.title: No calorie plan for you
minor.body: Under 18 you need energy to grow, so Kalo doesn’t calculate diet targets for you. You can still use Kalo to eat balanced – without calorie numbers. If you want to lose weight, please talk to your doctor.

invalid_input.title: Please check your details
invalid_input.body: Some values are outside the range Kalo can calculate sensibly.

underweight.title: We don’t recommend losing weight here
underweight.body: Your weight is already in the underweight range. We’re happy to help you maintain or build. If you’re worried about eating, please reach out to a support service for eating disorders.

target_underweight.title: This target weight is too low
target_underweight.body: For your height the healthy range starts at about {{kg}} kg. Please choose a target from that value.

target_direction.title: Goal and target weight don’t match
target_direction.body: The target weight points the other way. Please adjust your goal or target weight.

coach.checkInReadyHint: See how your plan matches your real expenditure.
coach.forecast: At this pace you’ll reach {{target}} kg on {{date}}.
coach.forecastTrend: Based on your weight trend ({{kg}} kg per week).
coach.forecastPlan: Based on your plan ({{kg}} kg per week) – after two weeks of weigh-ins Kalo uses your real trend.

insufficient_data.title: Not enough data yet
insufficient_data.body: To adjust, Kalo needs at least a week of fully logged days and regular weigh-ins (ideally every morning). Your target stays the same for now.

on_track.title: You’re right on track
on_track.body: Your weight is moving as planned ({{actual}} per week). Your target stays the same – keep going!

slower_than_planned.title: Progress is slower than planned
slower_than_planned.body: The plan was {{planned}} per week; actually it’s {{actual}}. Your body seems to burn a little less than estimated (about {{tdee}} kcal). Kalo suggests a small adjustment.

faster_than_planned.title: Progress is faster than planned
faster_than_planned.body: The plan was {{planned}} per week; actually it’s {{actual}}. You burn more than expected (about {{tdee}} kcal) – Kalo suggests eating a bit more so you keep muscle and energy.

expenditure_updated.title: Your expenditure was recalculated
expenditure_updated.body: Your pace is right, but your actual expenditure is about {{tdee}} kcal. Kalo adjusts your target to it.

coach.howItWorks: How the coach works: it smooths your weight into a trend, compares the change with the calories you ate and estimates your real expenditure from that. Your target changes by at most 150 kcal per week and never goes below a safe minimum.

charts.weightSummary: Weight from {{from}} to {{to}}: trend from {{start}} to {{end}} kilograms.

insights.protein_low_streak: You were below your protein target {{days}} days in a row. Skyr, legumes or chicken help you stay full and keep muscle.
insights.fiber_low: On average {{grams}} g of fibre – at least 30 g is recommended. Whole grains, vegetables and legumes add more.
insights.sugar_high: On average {{grams}} g of sugar per day. Fewer sugary drinks and sweets quickly make a difference.
insights.salt_high: On average {{grams}} g of salt – at most 6 g is recommended. Ready meals and cured meats are often the main source.
insights.water_low: You're drinking less than your water target. A glass with every meal is an easy start.
insights.streak: {{days}} days logged in a row – great!
insights.on_target: You were on target on {{pct}} % of days. Keep it up!
insights.protein_good: Your protein intake is looking great.
